title: Several injured after man ‘deliberately’ drives car into people on French island
summary: Two people in intensive care and a driver arrested after incident on Île d’Oléron on Wednesday, say authorities A driver rammed into pedestrians and cyclists on France’s tourist-frequented Île d’Oléron off the Atlantic coast on Wednesday, injuring several people including four seriously, authorities said. The 35-year-old driver was arrested by police and an investigation has been opened, the interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, said in a post on X. Continue reading...

title: Multiple people reported injured after car driven into pedestrians on French island – Europe live
summary: Interior minister says suspect is in custody after reports of a car intentionally ramming into pedestrians and cyclists on the island of Oleron The Sud-Ouest newspaper is quoting the local prosecutor, Arnaud Laraize, as saying that the suspect resisted arrest, and had to be tasered. The suspect is reported to be a man in his 30s and a resident of a nearby town of La Cotinière, with conflicting reports as to whether he was previously known to the authorities. Continue reading...

title: Companies Have Shielded Buyers From Tariffs. But Not for Long.

title: Floppy disks get a second life at Cambridge University Library
summary: A new program at the University of Cambridge library in the UK is asking people to bring in their floppy disks so that any digital artifacts on them can be extracted. Among rediscovered files are documents once belonging to Stephen Hawking, says technical analyst Leontien Talboom.
